title: Cryptographic Elliptic-Curve Addition Chains (20 Production Curves)
description: Twenty pure Lean 4.36.0 (zero Mathlib) kernel-verified shortest addition-chain hill-climb tracks for real production elliptic-curve field and scalar inversion exponents (Curve25519, NIST P-256/P-384/P-224/P-192, secp256k1/secp224k1/secp192k1, Ed448-Goldilocks, Curve41417, M-221/E-222/Curve1174/E-382/M-383/M-511), pinned verbatim to `mmcloughlin/addchain@6c4dbba3ac` (BSD-3-Clause). Every track starts from a clean 4-bit windowed baseline strictly above published `addchain` / Brian Smith frontiers.

tasks.title: Curve25519 Field p-2: minimize addition-chain length (baseline 329)
tasks.description: Find a shorter addition chain for the Curve25519 Field p-2 inversion exponent (seeded with a 4-bit fixed-window chain of 329 steps; `addchain`/Brian Smith frontier: 265). Edit `AddChain/ChainCurve25519Field.lean` (`AddChain.score_curve25519_field_inv` and `AddChain.steps_curve25519_field_inv`). Frozen Lean 4.36.0 kernel proofs verify well-formedness, step count, exact target value, and algebraic exponentiation soundness.
